raw: {"analysis":"Response XMG provides a more thorough and well-structured plan that correctly addresses all key constraints: immutability of audit logs (staging path first), credential rotation safety, CI cost management, Tuesday flake handling, dual approval gates, and rollback by simply disabling the new cron. Response KTM covers similar ground but has some gaps—it doesn't clearly address the Tuesday flaky check in its CI strategy, and its merge window logic (Thursday to avoid Friday rotation) is less clear than XMG's approach. XMG's plan is more actionable and leaves fewer follow-up questions, particularly around the staging log promotion and the explicit handling of the Tuesday network flake.","verdict": "XMG"}
